guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：記憶體控制器與 ECC
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Memory controllers and ECC
guides.concept: 以DRAM 時序、排程與可辨識更正連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect dram timing, scheduling and diagnosable correction through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「地址解碼」的資料、控制與時間關係。位址映射至通道、rank、bank 與列。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「將假想位元欄位填入地址。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「容量組織」的資料、控制與時間關係。rank、裝置寬度與容量不能混為一談。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「從假想裝置數重算容量。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Refresh 干擾」的資料、控制與時間關係。刷新佔用資源並延遲正常請求。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「把刷新窗口納入延遲分佈。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「SECDED 邊界」的資料、控制與時間關係。單錯更正雙錯偵測不等於任意錯誤復原。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較一位、兩位與多位案例。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「更正紀錄」的資料、控制與時間關係。更正事件需保留位置與時間。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分開總數與每 DIMM 趨勢。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「證據範圍」的資料、控制與時間關係。無錯誤紀錄可能代表未啟用報告。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「檢查監測覆蓋而非只看零值。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for address decoding. Addresses map to channel, rank, bank and row. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Fill assumed address bit fields. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for capacity organization. Ranks, device widths and capacities differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Recalculate capacity from assumed devices. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for refresh interference. Refresh consumes resources and delays requests. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Include refresh windows in latency distributions. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for secded limits. SECDED does not recover arbitrary errors. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare one-, two- and multibit cases. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for corrected-error records. Corrected events need location and timestamps. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Separate totals from per-DIMM trends. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for evidence scope. No error logs may mean reporting is disabled. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check monitoring coverage, not zeros alone. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「頻寬驗證」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核算本課峰值與利用率。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「證據範圍」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「無錯誤紀錄可能代表未啟用報告。」。
提交「證據範圍」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「檢查監測覆蓋而非只看零值。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit bandwidth validation input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit evidence scope two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit evidence scope input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：6400 MT/s 代表每秒 6400 百萬完整記憶體命令。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: 6400 MT/s means 6400 million full memory commands per second. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
guides.scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

related.difference: ECC 處理位元錯誤，一致性處理合法更新的可見性
related.differenceEn: ECC handles bit errors; coherence handles legal-update visibility
practice: 由「地址解碼」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「ECC 處理位元錯誤，一致性處理合法更新的可見性」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From address decoding, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "ECC handles bit errors; coherence handles legal-update visibility", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.
